author: reactive-end
summary: New anvil-prereqs crate detects required tools and versions (node, python, java, rust, go, dart, php, terraform, docker, sonar-scanner, uv, gh, Android), env keys from .env.example, MCP servers in .mcp.json (resolvable commands, archived packages, inline credentials) and secrets in agent configs; `anvil prereqs detect|check|script`, `anvil doctor --prereqs`, init stores the detected list per project/subrepo.
